headline: Western Coast Rekindles as Northern Meatgrinder Reaches Fever Pitch
war_summary: Since the previous dispatch, the frantic base exchanges in Linn of Mercy and Fisherman’s Row have subsided into sudden quiet, shifting active combat maneuvers westward to Farranac Coast. There, contested fighting around Transient Valley and The Bone Haft produced fresh clashes within the past two hours, reducing one strategic strongpoint to neutral ruins. Across the interior, base lines hold fast while attritional slaughter mounts to ferocious peaks. The butcher's bill in Stonecradle has surged to nearly four thousand casualties in two hours, with both factions trading ferocious volleys along contested sectors. In Weathered Expanse, casualty rates continue to accelerate aggressively, claiming more than three thousand men in the latest two-hour span around Crow’s Nest and Frostmarch. Further pressure mounts in Mooring County and Callahan’s Passage, where casualty rates have doubled over the past hour behind heavy fresh enlistments. Meanwhile, Dead Lands and Nevish Line report a sharp cooling in engagement tempo after hours of relentless battering.
